preconditions.expression: isinstance(s, str) and 1 <= len(s) <= 10**5 and all(c.islower() for c in s)
preconditions.description: The input is a string s of length between 1 and 10^5, consisting only of lowercase English letters.

postconditions.expression: len(results) == len(s) and all(isinstance(result, str) for result in results)
postconditions.description: The output consists of |s| lines, each containing a string result.

postconditions.expression: all(len(results[i]) == len(s) - i for i in range(len(s)))
postconditions.description: The length of the i-th result corresponds to the length of the i-th suffix of the input string s.

postconditions.expression: all(all(c.islower() for c in result) for result in results)
postconditions.description: Each result string consists only of lowercase English letters.

postconditions.expression: all(results[i] == ''.join(c for j, c in enumerate(s[i:]) if j == 0 or s[i + j] != s[i + j - 1]) for i in range(len(s)))
postconditions.description: Each result is the lexicographically smallest string obtained by removing pairs of consecutive equal characters from the i-th suffix of the input string s.

postconditions.expression: all(len(result) <= 10 or (len(result) == 10 and result[5:8] == '...') for result in results)
postconditions.description: If a result string is longer than 10 characters, it is formatted as the first 5 characters, followed by '...', followed by the last 2 characters.
